# Plane consistency on ETH3D electro (generated by `uv run python run.py`)

Evals harness at 190ed339f41924ae0244e0b88c5ebe647ddd9eb4 (t3/evals); the app's view gates and `record` replicated from HouseScanKit beede15. The 19.3 ft wall and truth of evals section 7. Feet along the wall. False-observed: claimed wall with 10 cm or more of band no photo saw (pass at 0.5 or less). Missed: band two photos 0.25 m apart saw, left unclaimed (pass at 3.3 or less).

## Validity

- The app without the filter, exact poses: claimed 19.3, false-observed 1.1, missed 0.0 (evals section 7: 19.3, 1.1, 0.0).
- The app's own code (the evals' built coverage-driver) agrees with the replicas on every wall sighting and claim in every pose setting: yes.
- Too plain: patch standard deviation below 0.906 grey levels, from a noise floor of 0.573 (measured this run: 0.573).

### Wall homography fitted to SIFT matches instead of taken from the poses

Matches must pass Lowe's ratio at 0.8, lie on the wall band's image, and land within 20 px of the pose homography's prediction; RANSAC at 3 px needs 20 inliers, else the pair keeps its pose homography. The offsets delta still come from the poses.
